setup_file: setup-corrected-38d3b030.json (post-hoc corrected commands; first pass stays NOT_QUALIFIED_setup_failed)
on_prereveal_source_rule: Overworld hidden blocks below y=0 mask to plain deepslate (Veil.java)
on_conservative_upper_ms: ore receive epoch - cover mutation HEAD epoch + 1
on_conservative_lower_ms: ore receive epoch - cover mutation RETURN epoch - 1
on_gate: valid anchor: upper<=50 PASS; lower>50 FAIL; straddles 50 INCONCLUSIVE; valid anchor and no ore update within 5000ms FAIL
fallback_gate: only if no server anchor: bot send-to-receive <=49ms = PASS-conservative with named 1ms uncertainty, assumes send precedes server mutation; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
off_control: valid cover mutation (return epoch recorded), then observe >=2500 ms, zero ore block updates -> OFF_OK; any update -> FAIL; shorter window -> INCONCLUSIVE; bare booleans never pass
cell_verdict: ON leg PASS needs 6 ON rows PASS and OFF leg OFF_OK; global precedence NOT_QUALIFIED, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE; see x4df_verdict.py
setup_validity: ON initial of both ores must equal on_initial and OFF initial must equal off_initial, else NOT_QUALIFIED
gate_impl: x4df_verdict.py r5; global precedence NOT_QUALIFIED > FAIL > INCONCLUSIVE > ON verdict, across both legs
head_return_rule: HEAD<=RETURN allowed (sub-ms mutation); 1 ms uncertainty already in upper/lower
normalizer_evidence_required_per_row: cover == expected cover of the ore cell
anchored_send_rule: send optional with a valid anchor; if present finite, >=0 and <= recv
